    from collections import Counter

    fg = fg_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

    # foreground marks support it.
    phases = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        pos = [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == fg]
        opts = [(sum(c % 2 == p for c in pos), p) for p in (0, 1)]
        n, phase = max(opts)
        if n >= 3:
            phases[r] = phase

    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        pos = [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == fg]
        if not pos:
            continue
        last = pos[-1]
        if last == w - 1:

            run += 1
            c -= 1

        # A repeated 3-column motif already reaches the right edge; do not
        # mistake it for an unfinished alternating stripe.
        periodic3 = False
        if w >= 12 and last >= w - 13:
            tail = row[w - 12:]
            periodic3 = (len(tail) == 12 and tail[:3] != [bg] * 3
                        and tail[:3] != [fg] * 3
                        and all(tail[i] == tail[i % 3] for i in range(12)))
        if periodic3:
            continue

        neighbor_phases = {phases[nr] for nr in (r - 1, r + 1)
                           if nr in phases and abs(nr - r) == 1}
